children: FDCTech entered into two Share Purchase Agreements to acquire Larstal UK and Larstal Denmark, both authorized electronic money institutions in the UK and Denmark, respectively. The aggregate base purchase price is $2.35 million, with deposits, additional payments upon filing change-in-control applications, monthly interim payments, and balances due at completion; FDCTech will also fund each target’s regulatory own funds and settle cash/debt adjustments at closing. Approvals from the FCA and DFSA are required, and pre-completion payments are non-refundable even if approvals are denied, except in cases of seller fraud. The deals are aimed at expanding FDCTech’s regulated e-money footprint across the UK and Denmark.
Agreement 1: FDCTech to Acquire Larstal UK for $1.175 Million, Pending FCA Approval
: Share Purchase Agreement to acquire 100% of Larstal UK
: Sergio Fogel and Andrés Bzurovski; AstroPay Global Holdings as guarantor
: Expand e-money footprint with FCA-regulated license
Agreement 2: FDCTech to Acquire Larstal Denmark for $1.175 Million, Pending DFSA Approval
: Share Purchase Agreement to acquire 100% of Larstal Denmark
: Larstal UK; AstroPay Global Holdings as guarantor
: Add DFSA-regulated e-money capabilities in Denmark
